facility_desc: Distribution-facility sales tax collection exemption (SC Code 12-36-2691, S.36 of 2011), enacted for the Amazon Lexington County order fulfillment center
program: SC Distribution Facility Sales Tax Exemption (temporary nexus moratorium, 2011-2015)
issuer: SC General Assembly (S.36, House staff summary 2011-05-24); SC Court of Appeals opinion 6047 (2024) describes the Moratorium
notes: Exemption from collecting and remitting sales tax; no physical-presence nexus for a qualifying distribution center until 2016-01-01 (court opinion: five years, 2011-01-01 to 2015-12-31). Court of Appeals: an Amazon subsidiary built two distribution facilities in SC in 2011 and 2012. Value not stated in any source obtained. Statewide law, recorded once against CAE1.
